description: Inbound citations: documents that cite, amend, correct, repeal, implement or are based on this act, with the edge type. For legislation, amendment / corrigendum / repeal edges are read from the Publications Office (Cellar) and refreshed on read when older than 7 days; if that refresh does not finish in ~2.5 s, relationSync.status is "pending" (or "skipped") and the stored edges are served — check relationSync before calling the list complete. Other edge types cover only documents LexAPI has extracted. Cost: 1 credit.

citationType.description: Only this edge type (e.g. "amendment" for the amending acts).

name: lex_cited_by
title: Documents citing a CELEX
